data.define: Used to tell someone to relax.

misuse.text: Don't tell a panicking friend to 'take it easy'.
misuse.why: It sounds like you ignore the urgency.

publish.title: What does "take it easy" mean?
publish.value: Take it easy = Relax, don't rush. Example: "Take it easy this weekend." (casual English, US).
